newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche says tax reform trigger for stake sales.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche says tax reform trigger for stake sales.

text.p: Rolf Breuer, the new chief executive of Deutsche Bank AG, said on Thursday evening that Deutsche had no plans to sell off its industrial holdings under current conditions but would do so following a tax reform.
"We cannot follow an active policy on our industrial holdings for as long as the tax collector takes away two thirds of the capital gains achieved," Breuer said.
"But I am optimistic that the tax rate (on the gains) will be cut to under 40 percent. If that happens we will have a totally different world from 1998," he said.

Deutche holds sizeable stakes in several major German companies, including Daimler-Benz AG and Metallgesellschaft AG. Many of its stakes have arisen as a result of rescue packages for financially troubled companies.
